expectation_source: Immutable original AC1 and plan2, read before separate claims. Initial full input print was inadvertently broad/truncated; no historical pass adopted.

assertions.requirement: Create and close a valid 16-byte magic-only FOZ; read it back through production StreamArchive: prepare succeeds, every resource set is empty, discovery is complete and total zero is known.
assertions.source_evidence: empty() writes 16-byte FOZ and checks every resource set and known zero; directory native/forced-unknown socket/link controls preserve exact regular-only scope.

assertions.requirement: Create E9 by cutting the first name/header and separately the first payload after valid magic; legacy prepare still salvages, no retained entries, discovery incomplete, unread item total unknown rather than zero, reason and first unread byte offset known. A zero-length OS file is not the intact-empty fixture.
assertions.source_evidence: truncated(0) separately cuts metadata/payload, checks salvage, boundary, reason, unknown totals; zero file is not fixture.

assertions.requirement: Write distinct checksum-protected known payloads, retain two whole entries and cut the next name/header or payload; metadata gives exact retained tag/hash union and prefix boundary, unknown unread total, and selected full-scope result unsuccessful.
assertions.source_evidence: truncated(2) uses checksum payloads at exact 60-byte entries and asserts retained count/boundary and discovered union.

assertions.requirement: Two-call read_entry yields exact intact payload bytes and hashes after prepare and after the report is queried. Preparation does not rewrite/truncate the input in ReadOnly mode. Full intact archive provides the successful control.
assertions.source_evidence: read_prefix performs two-call exact payload checks twice and source byte equality; intact control reads all3.

assertions.requirement: Real concurrent database with valid, missing and invalid/unreadable inputs retains every requested path/index/policy after failed children are discarded; opened/discovered/failed/excluded identities and reasons are exact.
assertions.source_evidence: inputs() exact_inputs independently constructs complete primary/extras/absent/invalid/duplicate tables.

assertions.requirement: Default legacy composite prepare and tolerant capture append behavior stay compatible; an explicit required input prevents full required-scope satisfaction, while an explicitly optional unavailable input is an exclusion of unknown item count and is never a success or failure item.
assertions.source_evidence: Default required scope rejected while library bool remains tolerant; explicit optional table and capture append control present.

assertions.requirement: Test both missing and unreadable/read-error paths deterministically: use a real absent file plus a private controlled file adapter for read/seek error, avoiding chmod-only permission assumptions when tests run as root. Known raw OS errors remain exact if available; format rejection has no invented errno.
assertions.source_evidence: Linux wrapped fseek/fread inject positive seek error and EIO/no-errno read failures after first retained entry; exact failed-child table survives discard and healthy sibling readback.

assertions.requirement: Include primary base plus extras, no primary, duplicate paths, duplicate logical tag/hash across inputs and the same hash under different tags; input observations remain distinct while logical scope is a deduplicated tag/hash union.
assertions.source_evidence: Primary/no-primary and duplicate path/hash plus shader same-hash tested; expected deduplicated logical vectors independent of observations.

assertions.requirement: Invalid/short magic, unsupported version, controlled failed seek/tell/header read and cancelled discovery are reason-bearing failed/incomplete states, not known empty success. All offsets/length calculations are checked with subtraction after bounds checks.
assertions.source_evidence: errors() invalid/short/version, seek/tell/header, cancellation checks; text_spans virtual uint32 limits and checked scan/subtraction/long movement source inspected.

assertions.requirement: Unknown or uninstrumented backend preparation remains explicitly unknown; default custom DatabaseInterface subclass report must not invent complete discovery. A subsequent valid independent database succeeds.
assertions.source_evidence: Custom subclass unchanged virtuals returns unknown; independent valid source succeeds before global cancellation.

assertions.requirement: Real source FOZ plus real whitelist/blacklist and implicit whitelist subdatabases yield exact prefilter logical universe, effective masks, selected set and exclusions by named policy; preserve existing shader-empty-whitelist semantics and union/precedence behavior.
assertions.source_evidence: filters() real source/white/black/implicit archives assert exact independent prefilter and selected sets, mask, shader behavior.

assertions.requirement: Observe filter exclusions at actual production scan/priming boundary before keys are discarded; do not infer an original universe from already-filtered get_hash_list results. Required missing/truncated filter input cannot silently become a known complete selection.
assertions.source_evidence: observe_discovered runs before test_resource_filter discard; missing/truncated filter facts required and scope rejected.

assertions.requirement: Omitted input, whitelist rejection and blacklist rejection are distinct from read/creation failure. Policy exclusions do not increment succeeded/failed counters.
assertions.source_evidence: Exact key/policy tuple sets separate whitelist/blacklist; selected dispatch counters checked in production filtering.

assertions.requirement: Table covers all three pipeline tags, default full interval, empty interval, exact bounds, partially and wholly out-of-bounds half-open ranges, start beyond end under the declared existing clamping policy, and explicit hash selection including missing hashes.
assertions.source_evidence: ranges() seven half-open clamping rows over three tags plus present/missing hash table.

assertions.requirement: Ranges use deterministic sorted filtered hash order and report requested interval, effective interval, exact selected tag/hash and excluded logical tag/hash sets. Duplicates are one logical item; same hash under another tag is separate.
assertions.source_evidence: Sorted input vector, requested/effective interval, exact complement tuple sets reject duplicates/invented exclusions; tag/hash identity retained.

assertions.requirement: Filter then range order is explicit; narrowing a range, choosing zero items or a present hash does not turn an unknown required unread tail into complete full-input discovery.
assertions.source_evidence: selection_filters verifies filter-before-range; prefix_policy tests zero and narrowed real selection/present hash cannot hide required tail.

assertions.requirement: Default full scope rejects recovered/truncated required input even if every discovered selected item succeeds or filters/ranges select no items.
assertions.source_evidence: prefix_policy actual run_normal_process rejects truncated required source before any creation, even zero selection; hints repeats all-hinted unknown controls.

assertions.requirement: Explicit accept-recovered-prefix names each opened input and retained byte boundary, selected known tag/hash union and exclusion policy; it can satisfy only that prefix selection while original discovery and unread total remain incomplete/unknown.
assertions.source_evidence: Explicit prefix fixture checks requested policy, named input retained boundary and actual production two creations while original unknown survives.

assertions.requirement: A missing/unreadable required input cannot be converted into an accepted recovered prefix; optional unknown inputs remain named input exclusions. No full-coverage percentage is inferred from a zero selected count.
assertions.source_evidence: Missing required composite remains unsatisfied even prefix; optional absent input named; all24 source/required/filter/prefix compositions include failed-filter precedence.

assertions.requirement: Create a known dependency-complete recorder fixture with all three pipeline kinds, run successful creation, teardown/reopen and explicitly harvest replay-v1 fragments using existing merge behavior; subsequent production dispatch suppresses exactly hinted tag/hash items.
assertions.source_evidence: hints() cache_input/real production create/harvest/reopen across three kinds suppresses exact hinted key.

assertions.requirement: Report exact hint exclusions and version/device/UUID namespace policy separately from whitelist/range exclusions, retain stable prehint indices required by robust resume, and record zero actual creation calls for hinted items and expected calls for unhinted items.
assertions.source_evidence: Exact hint policy, exclusions and mixed actual creation key/original worker index checked via private adapter; stable prehint hashes retained.

assertions.requirement: Legacy UUID-only, unknown namespace, unavailable optional hint DB and nonmatching device mode cannot become successful work or hide unknown discovery. Hints prove neither physical Vulkan compilation nor driver cache hit or durable persistence. Existing validation whitelist behavior stays independent.
assertions.source_evidence: Inherited cache_legacy_provenance/cache_null_provenance/cache_whitelist cover namespace/mode/optional legacy behavior; all-hinted unknown source rejects before creation.

assertions.requirement: Export/import the actual production OS metadata handle for intact, truncated-zero, prefix, missing optional and missing required composite inputs; reopened reports preserve paths/indexes, policy, scan state, unknown counts, prefix boundary, filtered/excluded sets and exact readable payloads.
assertions.source_evidence: metadata() real OS handles seven scenarios; exact input_facts compares every scalar, mixed filter policies independent tuple sets, payload readback.

assertions.requirement: Do not reconstruct complete discovery from imported hash-list length. Portable Windows named mapping and Linux FD mechanisms share semantic assertions; reject malformed/unsupported private metadata records with bounded size checks.
assertions.source_evidence: Malformed real mappings corrupt size/list/schema/count and reject; decode bounded subtraction and alignment inspected; imported report not inferred from key length.

assertions.requirement: Private metadata is same-commit only; worker reason frames and SharedControlBlock fields/layout/version retain their existing meaning.
assertions.source_evidence: Exact-commit-only docs retained; no worker-frame or SharedControlBlock diff; report private magic/schema separate.

assertions.requirement: Use real null-device CLI normal, direct slave, master and progress processes, one/four threads where supported; process watchdogs, isolated working dirs and actual exit statuses are the outcome oracle. Empty intact succeeds; full-scope truncated-zero/prefix and required missing/unreadable input return nonzero.
assertions.source_evidence: replay_discovery_cli.cmake real4 modes x threads1/4, per-process deadlines and actual ordinary exit oracle for empty/truncated/prefix/required/invalid.

assertions.requirement: Explicit prefix acceptance succeeds for a valid prefix and names that scope in the structured in-process result exercised by the production fixture; default full discovery remains incomplete. Optional input policy succeeds only for remaining declared scope and retains unavailable-input exclusion.
assertions.source_evidence: CLI explicit-prefix and optional policies execute actual processes; in-process report and call checks cover named scope.

assertions.requirement: Actual production selection/dispatch fixture observes the report returned by the helper used by shipping paths, plus parse/create call set, not a parallel toy model. Assertions inspect typed metadata without parsing human prose.
assertions.source_evidence: replay_selection_test includes actual shipping replay cpp through existing private fixture, observes selection_report and Vulkan creation adapter.

assertions.requirement: Master must check discovery before zero-worker shortcuts and before metadata export; progress forwards policy through ExternalReplayer; children importing metadata cannot erase required uncertainty. Direct-child whitelist selection remains the existing unsupported invocation boundary; test the supported controller-imported filtered metadata path instead.
assertions.source_evidence: Both controllers call scope helper before metadata export/zero-worker; direct zero-assignment slaves independently prepare/import; filtered imported path covered metadata fixtures.

assertions.requirement: Unsuccessful preparation cannot be erased by quiet/progress absence, all-hinted work, zero selected range or another successful input. No test-only flag/hook is installed in shipping CLI.
assertions.source_evidence: Normal scope check before parsing/static/create; progress resolves scope and additive policy setter forwards both launchers; all-hinted/zero-range/mixed required inputs retained; no shipping test hook.

assertions.requirement: Extract actual input headers from fd380aafe1df5a5379216d70c4fe4bfcf7f4b5db and put them before candidate includes; compile and link unchanged recorder/database/custom subclass and ExternalReplayer Options{} callers with candidate libraries, then execute valid/empty ordinary invocations.
assertions.source_evidence: replay_discovery_compatibility.cmake extracts actual fd380 headers before candidate and compiles/links/runs unchanged recorder/custom/diagnostic/external Options callers.

assertions.requirement: No new pure virtual method or required override is imposed on old DatabaseInterface subclasses. Preserve legacy bool prepare salvage and tolerant composite behavior for existing library/capture callers while additive report/policy APIs describe limits.
assertions.source_evidence: Public report methods additive nonvirtual; old custom overrides unchanged; truncated salvage and tolerant append/composite fixtures explicit.

assertions.requirement: Preserve original healthy CLI flags, metadata same-commit contract, worker #18 records and shared progress schema. Intentionally changed replay behavior is documented: required incomplete discovery now returns nonzero unless explicit recovered-prefix policy; binary ABI for arbitrary prebuilt C++ consumers and mixed-version private metadata are not claimed.
assertions.source_evidence: Old CLI modes/flags/backends compatibility registered; no worker grammar/shared progress diff, docs disclose intended nonzero and no broad ABI/mixed-version promise.

assertions.requirement: Build unchanged input replay executable and run candidate-generated/readback-checked E9 fixture and valid empty control using old supported flags. Baseline empty succeeds; baseline E9 false-success exit zero is recorded by a baseline-compatible checker, while candidate E9 must be nonzero. Compile/deadline/crash failures are not defect reproduction.
assertions.source_evidence: original-defect CMake uses old flags, checks baseline empty/E9 zero plus candidate empty zero/E9 ordinary nonzero in all4 modes.

assertions.requirement: In disposable candidate copies, mutate only (a) sliced-tail completeness to complete, (b) discard missing required input identity/policy or bypass full-scope gate, (c) unknown unread total to known zero, (d) filtered/ranged/hinted exclusion accounting, and (e) imported completeness propagation. Every mutation must build and fail a named explicit D20/M20 runtime assertion, with an appropriate unaffected healthy control still passing.
assertions.source_evidence: Five exact source-only mutations independently configure/build; check-mutation requires unaffected healthy0 then ordinary1 with named explicit assertion.

assertions.requirement: Controls cannot pass by expecting a compiler error from compiling new APIs against an old header; baseline behavior probe uses only old flags/API. Retain mutation patch, exact source/candidate, compile status, expected assertion name and execution status.
assertions.source_evidence: controls manifest preserves source anchor/count/patch/case/assertion; compile/deadline/crash cannot count as sensitivity.
